setup: Stand side-on to the band anchor, elbow bent at a right angle against a rolled towel at your side.
cues: Rotate the band out toward the wall beside you on a slow, smooth path.

The elbow stays parked on its spot, like hinged to the wall.

Return slow on a three-count.
